chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali al-Hamdani, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kasa'i, from Maysar (the seller of black slaves), and Khalid said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
"Eat onions, for in them are three characteristics: they improve the breath, strengthen the gums, and increase the semen and sexual drive."
ai.seo_question: What are the three health benefits of onions mentioned by Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) recommendation of onions, highlighting their tripartite benefits: freshening breath, strengthening gums, and enhancing sexual vitality. This narration reflects the Prophetic tradition of utilizing common foods for both physical health and spiritual readiness, emphasizing the holistic well-being valued in Shia jurisprudence and medicine.
